_comment: Hand-curated extra names for Kaiserreich locations, merged into provinces.json by tools/parse_hoi4_reference.py --mod kaiserreich. Keys MUST be canonical display names already in KR's provinces.json (the parser warns about any that aren't); values are alternative spellings a Discord poster might write in [Location:...]. NOTE the direction differs from base HoI4: in Kaiserreich the Bolsheviks never took Russia and the Ottomans never fell, so the PRE-revolutionary names are canonical — Tsaritsyn not Stalingrad, Petrograd not Leningrad, Constantinople not Istanbul, Smyrna not Izmir. The Soviet-era names below are listed as aliases so posters typing from vanilla-HoI4 habit still pin correctly. Keys with a leading underscore are ignored as comments.
